question: Which of the following international organisation is the governing body of Chess?
solution:
The correct answer is __**FIDE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Chess Federation or World Chess Federation is commonly referred to by its French acronym FIDE.
 
• It is an international organization based in Switzerland that connects the various national chess federations and acts as the governing body of international chess competitions. 
 
• World Chess Federation:
 
 
• Headquarters: Lausanne, Switzerland
 
• President: Arkady Dvorkovich
 
• Founded: 20 July 1924, Paris, France
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e83e630b8277aa39b56a8e929012a2387c38949ce725d789f43bf8cd23748dde.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Cricket Council

 
 
• It is the world governing body of cricket.
 
• It was founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference in 1909.
 
• It was founded by representatives from Australia, England, and South Africa.
 
• It was renamed the International Cricket Conference in 1965.
 
• Headquarters of ICC: Dubai, UAE.
 
• Chairman: Greg Barclay (as of April 2022)
 
• It took its current name in 1987.
 
 

 
• International Olympic Committee (IOC):

 
 
• One non-governmental organization involved in sports is the International Olympic Committee.
 
• It is situated in Switzerland's Lausanne.
 
• Pierre de Coubertin founded the IOC on June 23, 1894.
 
• Demetrios Vikelas served as its first president. 
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) oversees both the national Olympic Committees (NOCs) and the global Olympic Movement.
 
• Thomas Bach is its president at the moment.
 
• Every four years, the IOC plans the Youth Olympic Games (YOG) and the contemporary Olympic Games, which are held in the summer and winter. 
 
 
• The inaugural Summer Olympics took place in 1896 in Athens, Greece.
 
• While the first Winter Olympics took place in 1924 in Chamonix, France. 
 
• In 2010, Singapore hosted the first Summer YOG, while Innsbruck hosted the first Winter YOG in 2012.
 
 
 
 
 
• The Athens Summer Olympics, 1896: 
 
 
• It featured 14 sports and 241 athletes from 14 countries.
 
• The opening ceremony was held at the Panathenaic Stadium, which had been used for the ancient Olympic Games.
 
• Greek runner Spyridon Louis won the marathon..
 
• The United States topped the medal table with 11 gold medals.
 
 
 
• **​FIFA**
 
 
• Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) was established at Paris, France.
 
• It is a non-profit organization and currently the highest international governing body related to the sport of Football.
 
• Initially, it was established to organize and administer the football competitions among some European Nations.
 
• As of now, 211 national associations have affiliations with FIFA and FIFA supports them financially and logistically.
 
• Headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland.
 
• President: Gianni Infantino.
 
• Motto: For the Game, For the World.
